name: The Need for Speed: Special Edition
author: Buyukcaglar
description:
Native PS Vita version of The Need for Speed: Special Edition (Electronic Arts, 1996), made by static recompilation of the game's Windows 95 program with a host layer for the Vita. It is not an emulator or a source port.
The picture uses the Vita's 960x544 screen. Enhanced 3D draws the race's 3D scene at the screen's resolution instead of 640x480, and widescreen race shows the race at 16:9. Speeds can be shown in km/h or mph. Settings, best times and replays are saved. On a PlayStation TV a DUALSHOCK 3 or 4 vibrates with the game's force feedback effects.
The VPK contains no game data: your own copy of the PC game is needed (English files). Network play, languages other than English and touch input are not included.
requirements: - Game Data Files: PC. Copy NFS_WIN.EXE and the FRONTEND, GAMEDATA and SIMDATA folders of your own copy of The Need for Speed: Special Edition to ux0:data/NFSSE/GAME/
